## Latest Release

### Version 0.3.2 (September 2026)

**Annotation tab**

-   New **Select** tool (`V`) to select and move whole vessels and single vertices
-   `Ctrl+Z` now undoes the polygon edits
-   Each vessel shows again the scale zone it belongs to (Z1, Z2, ...) on the canvas and in the lists

**Export**

-   Cards are numbered in the natural order of the plates (page 2 before page 10) instead of alphabetical order
-   `merged_annotations.csv` keeps the type, position and rotation of each vessel (they were lost when merging with the classification file)

**Models**

-   When PyPotteryLens is started from the launcher, the YOLO and classifier weights are stored in the suite's shared model cache and appear in the launcher's *Downloaded AI Models* list. Weights found in the old folder are moved there once. Started on its own, nothing changes

**Interface and reliability**

-   New header and About window, in the style of the other modules, with a hardware chip and a *Copy citation* button
-   Fonts and icons are served from the app, so the interface looks the same without an internet connection
-   Crashes are reported with a timestamp and the name of the thread that failed, which makes problems easier to diagnose

## Version History

### Version 0.3.1 (July 2026)

**Key Features:**

-   Hardware Eligibility Guardrail: the local AI extraction model now checks your GPU/CPU/RAM before downloading, and blocks the download with a clear explanation on underpowered hardware
-   Fixed local model loading on recent `transformers` versions

### Version 0.3.0

**Annotation tab**

-   Nested vessel support: new Polygon tool (LabelMe-style) to outline by hand vessels drawn inside other vessels, which the model would otherwise miss; each polygon is extracted as its own card, and the inner area is whitened out of the containing card
-   Zoom & pan on the canvas, and a visible ring cursor for the brush and eraser
-   Colorize mode: every disconnected mask region gets a distinct hue, so fused regions are immediately visible

**Tabular tab**

-   AI extraction improvements: dynamic token budget prevents truncated JSON, and a robust parser recovers partial responses
-   Canonical column names via `[square brackets]` in the prompt
-   "Numbers from crops" option for small inventory numbers, for both single-page and batch extraction
-   Box visibility toggle and a Clear Table button
-   "Export Combined CSV" removed: tabular data is read directly from `cards/mask_info.csv` at export time

**Post Processing tab**

-   Grid view showing all pieces at real relative size, replacing the one-at-a-time navigator
-   Per-card hover controls (flip, ENT/FRAG toggle, exclude from export) and a full-screen lightbox
-   Blue/orange borders for ENT/FRAG; auto-flip options are now toggle switches

**Export and fixes**

-   All metadata fields are written as plain text in the output CSV
-   Fixed the flip endpoint acting on the wrong card when filenames sorted lexicographically rather than naturally
-   Fixed the small-vessel area filter (it was 4x too large because it counted RGBA channels)

### Version 0.2.1 (December 2025)

**Key Features:**

-   Added Pixel
-   Minor UI improvements

### Version 0.2.0 (December 2025)

**Key Features:**

-   Major architectural change: Migrated from Gradio to Flask web framework
-   Project Management System: Introduced project-based workflow with dedicated workspaces
-   Modern Web Interface: Native HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend with improved UX
-   RESTful API: Full API for programmatic access and future integrations
-   Enhanced Canvas Editor: Improved annotation tools with better performance
-   Real-time Progress Tracking: Live updates for long-running operations
-   Auto-save Everything: Automatic persistence for all user changes
-   Workflow Status Tracking: Visual indicators for project completion stages
-   Multi-project Support: Work on multiple datasets simultaneously
-   Improved Error Handling: Better user feedback and error recovery

### Version 0.1.3 (August 2025)

**Key Features:**

-   Minor bug fixes and performance improvements

### Version 0.1.0 (April 2025)

**Key Features:**

-   Initial release of documentation.
-   Basic project management and PDF processing.
-   Integration of CV models for mask extraction.
